answer: Treat the network like a garden with one water budget per root. Every identity traces its funding and invite path back to a source, and all identities draining the same lagoon split a single reward cap instead of each taking a full share. A farmer can spawn a thousand clones, but they still sip from one pool. Past that ridge, the only way to earn more is to win grades from peers outside your own funding tree, which clones cannot fake cheaply.
